title: bouea oppositifolia var. roxburghii
intro: Bouea oppositifolia var. roxburghii, commonly known as Bunga Telang, is a variety of the Bouea oppositifolia plant, a species of flowering plant native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its vibrant red flowers, which are used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Bouea oppositifolia var. roxburghii include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
